description: Source code for the Mattermost server API related to access control policies, including creation, retrieval, deletion, expression checking, and permission management.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API struct for handling access control policy endpoints.

methods.name: InitAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Initializes API routes for access control policy management based on feature flags.

methods.name: createAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Creates a new access control policy after validating permissions and input.

methods.name: getAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves an access control policy by ID, with permission checks.

methods.name: deleteAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Deletes an access control policy after permission validation.

methods.name: checkExpression
methods.description: Checks the validity of a given expression within a channel or system context.

methods.name: testExpression
methods.description: Tests an expression against users, returning matching users and count.

methods.name: validateExpressionAgainstRequester
methods.description: Validates if an expression matches the requester.

methods.name: searchAccessControlPolicies
methods.description: Searches for access control policies based on provided criteria.

methods.name: updateActiveStatus
methods.description: Deprecated: Batch updates the active status of policies; uses header-based auth only.

methods.name: setActiveStatus
methods.description: Sets active status for multiple policies, validating permissions.

methods.name: assignAccessPolicy
methods.description: Assigns a policy to channels after permission validation.

methods.name: getChannelsForAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves channels associated with a policy.

methods.name: searchChannelsForAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Searches channels within a policy context.

methods.name: getFieldsAutocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for access control fields.

methods.name: convertToVisualAST
methods.description: Converts an expression to its visual AST representation.
